Counts carry the unit the source counts in: an unlabelled number is records, and figure, file and harvest-listing counts (Open-i figures, Wikimedia Commons files, the PhysioNet, TCIA and grand-challenge listings) are labelled and are never added to a record count. Q.: queries whose request went out. Not sent: queries the protocol plans that this run did not send, because the source has no adapter in this version or a credential it requires was absent; the reason is in the Credential mode cell of a row that sent nothing, and in Appendix~\ref{app:search} for every id. Hits: sum of the totals each query reported (queries overlap; records are de-duplicated in the flow); -- where no query of the source reported a total, which is not a total of zero. Fetched: items the source handed over, before the review's own local filter. Retrieved: records kept after that filter, from analysis/flow.json where it has an entry, else summed over the source's queries; Fetched above Retrieved is the local filter working, and Fetched below the cap on a capped query is a paging failure. ``no answer'': the source's requests mostly failed to answer (transport error or 5xx), which is not the finding that it returned no records. Identified: records this source contributed to the flow after within-source de-duplication (analysis/flow.json); -- where the flow has no entry. Sources returning at least one record (Retrieved $>$ 0): 23 of 30 planned. A row with -- in every count column is a planned source no query was sent to, with the recorded reason in the Credential mode cell. Date: earliest request timestamp recorded for the source, blank when no request was sent; never the render's run date. O1 is the citation-chasing arm, not a numbered source; R9a and R10a are the mention harvests run over the other sources' records, which belong to R9 and R10 and are not separate planned sources. Planned but not run in this run: F2 MultiCaRe -- no search adapter in this version: MultiCaRe is a charting-time route; F3 Open-PMC-18M -- no search adapter in this version: Open-PMC-18M is a charting-time route.\par}
